title: Classic Pot Roast
description: A beef chuck roast braised low and slow with onions, carrots and potatoes until fork-tender, with the pan juices made into gravy.
equipment: Large Dutch oven with a lid

image.alt: Pot roast with carrots and potatoes in gravy

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 300F oven}. Pat the roast dry and season all over with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in the pot over medium-high heat and sear the roast until deeply browned on all sides, {time 10-12 min} total. Move to a plate.
Add the onions and cook for {time 4 min}, then the garlic and tomato paste for {time 1 min}. Pour in the broth and Worcestershire, scraping up the browned bits.
Return the roast, add the thyme and rosemary, cover and braise in the oven for {time 2 hr}.
Add the carrots and potatoes around the roast, cover and return to the oven until the meat pulls apart easily with a fork, {time 60-90 min}.

Move the meat and vegetables to a platter. Skim the fat from the juices, bring them to a simmer and whisk in the cornstarch mixed with {qty 2 tbsp} cold water. Simmer until thickened, {time 1-2 min}, and pour over the roast.

notes: If the roast isn’t tender yet, it needs more time, not less; tough connective tissue only softens with long, gentle cooking.
